extDescription.message: Shows, on your own computer, which third parties the page you are viewing contacts. Counts, not verdicts. Sends nothing.

headline.message: tracking services contacted before your first click

stoppedBrowser.message: blocked by your browser's tracking protection: $1

noInteraction.message: You have not clicked or typed on this page yet.

notMeasured.message: This site is not in our weekly measurement.

honesty.message: We see that a request happened, not what was sent or what the company does with it. The list is limited: this is not complete protection.

noData.message: No report for this tab yet. Open a web page in this tab, or reload it if it was already open before the extension started.

toldTitle.message: What your browser told this site

toldNote.message: Every server contacted also sees your IP address, which the browser cannot show. These details stay in this browser's memory for this tab and are never sent anywhere; cookie and parameter values are never kept.

consentContacted.message: Consent tool contacted: $1 (no banner seen on screen)

whyTitle.message: Why your number can differ from the weekly one

whyExtension.message: An extension in your browser stopped $1 third-party requests before they went out.

whyBrowserProtection.message: Your browser's own tracking protection stopped $1 requests.

whyCancelled.message: $1 requests were cancelled before going out; some may have been stopped by a blocker.

whyOtherBrowser.message: You are using $1; the weekly measurement uses Chromium, and browsers block different things.

whyCache.message: $1 requests were answered from your browser's cache.

whyTagManagers.message: Tag managers on this page ($1) load other scripts, which can change from one visit to the next.

whyPlace.message: The weekly measurement ran from $1; your browser asks for pages in $2. Country and language change what ads and services load.

whyAge.message: The weekly figure is $1 days old.

whyTruncated.message: This page made too many requests: the report stops at a limit.

whyAuctions.message: Live ad auctions pick different companies on every visit.
